page_title: BHA 2-2 LIV | Brighton v Liverpool 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
90+3' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
89' Substitution. Joao Pedro makes way for Ansu Fati (Brighton).
87' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired well wide of the right post.
86' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) earns the yellow card.
84' Joao Pedro (Brighton) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
84' Brighton work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
83' Two players stand over the free kick. Pascal Gross (Brighton) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
82' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece. Brighton have a free kick.
81' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) commits a foul during an attacking move.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Trent Alexander-Arnold cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' 2 - 2 A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Solly March and Lewis Dunk (Brighton) gets in a shot, sending the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
78' A free kick is awarded to Brighton. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Simon Adingra (Brighton) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
77' Brighton keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
75' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
73' The substitution is prepared. Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Joel Matip.
71' Referee Anthony Taylor halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Roberto De Zerbi, then shows him a yellow.
70' Solly March (Brighton) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

70' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
69' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
67' This is a yellow card! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

65' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Bart Verbruggen was alert and the score remained the same.
65' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
63' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Igor will be replaced by Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton).
62' Igor (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

60' Liverpool slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Danny Welbeck (Brighton) for Evan Ferguson.
58' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
58' Solly March (Brighton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
56' Solly March (Brighton) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
55' What a chance that is! Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
53' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) was too forceful with his tackle and Anthony Taylor interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
52' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
51' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

49' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Simon Adingra (Brighton) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Alisson pulls off an easy save.
48' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
48' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Jurgen Klopp probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Harvey Elliott. He is replaced by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Bart Verbruggen.
45+1' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

45+1' Pascal Gross (Brighton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Liverpool.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
40' 1 - 1 Goal! Darwin Nunez produces a great pass that finds Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
40' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.

38' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Brighton win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
37' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) attempts to find Mohamed Salah with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
34' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Joao Pedro (Brighton).
31' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
30' Simon Adingra (Brighton) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Kaoru Mitoma, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
29' The corner from Joel Veltman (Brighton) is cleared away by the defence.
28' Pascal Gross (Brighton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Brighton will take a corner kick.
28' Brighton take a short corner kick.
27' Pascal Gross (Brighton) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Brighton get a corner.
25' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
24' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
23' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
23' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Liverpool have a corner.
20' 1 - 0 GOAL! Simon Adingra (Brighton) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
20' Joel Veltman (Brighton) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
18' Joao Pedro (Brighton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
17' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) commits a foul after dangerous play.
16' Igor (Brighton) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
12' Joao Pedro (Brighton) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
12' Joao Pedro (Brighton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
11' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
11' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
7' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
6' Solly March (Brighton) makes a strong challenge and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul. Liverpool have a free kick from a promising distance.
6' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Joao Pedro (Brighton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
6' The referee points to the corner flag and Brighton will take a corner.
5' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.
3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' The Liverpool players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
